message:
[New Task Reminder] 1. Project root directory is <#projectroot#>.
2. T1 standard action is to use script to query complete unread messages: execute command with exec tool: `python <#projectroot#>/.data/scripts/chat_manager.py inbox --reader '<Name>' --last 20`, strictly prohibited to verbally say it has been queried.
3. For subordinate [STATUS] messages, no reply is needed. After obtaining unread messages, please immediately execute T2 standard action.

[Message Clear Reminder] 1. Team group chat system has no unread messages. Please send reminder messages to members who have not completed their tasks. Also, you decide whether the team task is completed, but please strictly audit tasks with a fault-finding, distrustful, and suspicious attitude. Do not easily conclude that the task is completed.
2. If the team task is completed, please report to your superior (human user) in the group chat and form a document, and please stop sending group chat messages to avoid message loops.
3. If the team task is not completed, please send group chat messages to notify relevant personnel to continue executing tasks. This is also mandatory!

You prematurely stopped the task and failed to execute the standard actions T4 and T5, which violates the prohibition! There is no need to execute standard action T1 again. Check whether the tasklist file created earlier has been completed, check whether standard action T3 has been executed, please continue to complete the unfinished tasks, and finally, you must complete this task with standard action T5!
[Member Status Reminder] <#name#> has stopped responding but has not provided group chat feedback information.
Please do not check unread messages anymore. You just checked them, so the messages are empty. Stop thinking and immediately execute subsequent standard actions!

[Tool Call Reminder] You did not call any tools in this session. Think about where your task has progressed. The project root directory is <#projectroot#>. **You must use the exec tool to execute commands.** Strictly prohibited to verbally say standard actions have been completed. Past completions do not count. Please use the script tool to complete group chat unread message retrieval or feedback sending!

compaction.focus_instructions: Please retain project development-related decisions, uncompleted tasks, and correct tool usage methods. Remove repetitive reasoning, circular thinking, invalid content, and incorrect cognition.

context_optimization.description: Historical round tool message cleanup: Strip completed Round's toolCall/toolResult, only retain user messages and assistant pure text replies. Current active Round fully retains tool messages (dependency chain not interrupted). toolCall compressed to path summary: [toolName]: /path/to/file.
context_optimization.note: When enabled=true, automatically cleans historical message tool noise before each LLM call, reducing about 80% context waste. Recommended to enable after stable operation.
